_comment: Ordered suffix-stripping rules for simple_stem() in common/corpus.py.
First match wins, so the list is NOT alphabetical and must stay in this order:
longer/more-specific suffixes come before shorter ones ('ations' before
's', 'ies' before 'es'), otherwise 'regulations' would only lose its 's'.
Lives here rather than in .env because it is a rule table, not a setting:
the same on every machine, and unreadable as a single env-var line. Same
class of file as synonyms.json beside it. Edit only if you intend to change
how BM25 tokenises -- every Stage-1 number moves if you do.
